summary: United States Antimony Corp filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $100 million of its common stock. The program permits open-market, privately negotiated, block trades, and Rule 10b5-1 plans, has no fixed expiration, and may be suspended or discontinued anytime. No specific price, premium, or timeline were disclosed. The company acts as issuer returning capital to shareholders. Watch for actual repurchase activity and market reaction; no risk-arb spread applies as this is not a merger-related buyback.
